sayLines.line: 🤒 Boris is on the mend — the fever broke.
📨 Word came: Elif Demir wants to join Haven. "My village is gone. Yours isn't. That's the whole of it." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.
🤒 Rocco is on the mend — the fever broke.
Denise is gone — the moot doesn't try the dead. The cases die with the accused; the fire remembers the rest.
📓 Codex: The old argument between Denise and Iván ended — one of them is gone.
Investigate and the morning is gone — tracking them costs a full day-part. Bar the door and you learn nothing. Your call.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
Iván is gone — the moot doesn't try the dead. The case dies with the accused; the fire remembers the rest.
🤒 Boris is on the mend — the fever broke.
🤒 Ava is on the mend — the fever broke.

Your ears ring, then go cotton-quiet. (DEAFENED — the beat count is gone, but the beat isn’t.)
The music is gone — cotton quiet. But you can feel the floor thump. (Deaf: no beat count. The kick still comes.)

💛 You hold Trail compass. Lost above the fog line, visibility down to your boots. You didn't panic — just held the compass flat, found north, and walked out like it was nothing. It was not nothing. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)
